The '''Ithorian section''' was an area of the [[Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden]] on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. The section was planted with [[bafforr tree]]s from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], which were dangerous to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|armor]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
